title: Luxuriantly Buttery Brazilian Tomato Skillet
description: A rich and savory Brazilian dish featuring baby plum tomatoes, perfect for a hangover cure, served on a wooden board. This recipe is FODMAP friendly and made with simple ingredients.
instructions: Heat the garlic-infused oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the halved baby plum tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the unsalted butter to the skillet and stir until melted and combined with the tomatoes.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them with the tomatoes and butter.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to a wooden board and top with grated cheese and chopped parsley.
Return the skillet to the stovetop and cook over low heat until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
